name_cn: 山东雷诺服饰有限公司
main_products: Men's suits, blazers, double-breasted and peak-lapel suits, sport blazers, trousers, coats, uniforms
woven_evidence: Tailored suits and blazers are woven garments, and the supplier focuses on suiting.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The Tai'an city 137th fair booth allocation table lists 山东雷诺服饰有限公司 under Men's & Women's Wear (男女装), Phase 3, with 1 standard booth.

notes: Made-in-China gives it as Manufacturer & Trading, BV-audited (MIC-ASR2551375), with 512 employees. It reports being a Daiyin Group subsidiary with 12 garment factories, and claims BSCI and ISO 9001. Published contact: Mr. William Zhang.
